notes.subject: sigi / ואכרתה
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'cut' a covenant (karat, from cutting animals between the pieces); Bambara idiom is 'layidu sigi' (establish a pact).

notes.subject: hesed Dawid
notes.rationale: 'the hesed of David' — faithful covenant-loves promised to David; read by later tradition as David himself or as the Davidic heir; kept literal 'hesed'.

notes.subject: to the hearers
notes.rationale: imperatives incline, come, hear — the summons continues.

notes.subject: aw ka ni / נפשכם
notes.rationale: נפש is life-force/breath, not an immortal 'soul'; rendered 'ni' per the standing glossary.

translation: Aw ka aw tulo bɛn ne ma, aw na ne fɛ; aw mɛn, aw ka ni bɛna balo; ne bɛ aw ni layidu ten sigi, Dawid (Dawuda) ka hesed, minnu ka tiɲɛ.
